title: Pitches from women that provide concrete details regarding the amount or variety of their inventory are associated with increased funding speed.
Female borrowers who mention the timing of investment or access to resources fund faster.
Female borrowers who include their specific age in the pitch may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention NWTF as a previous lender may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention the number of children may fund faster.
Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.
Female borrowers who mention their age or number of children fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention family status or specific children may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who explicitly address or thank the lenders may fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention previous loans from NWTF fund faster.
Female borrowers who describe themselves as a 'hardworking entrepreneur' fund more slowly.
